items.title: Carlsberg India prepares to file IPO papers this week, eyes $700 million
items.description: Carlsberg India, the country's second-largest brewer, is expected to begin investor roadshows next week and could launch the IPO as early as December

items.title: AI-led IPOs may add up to $100 billion to India's market-cap: Goldman Sachs
items.description: The investment bank estimates that 25-50 per cent of nearly 70 mid-to-late-stage private AI companies could go public in the next two to five years.

items.title: Jio Platforms IPO fully subscribed in less than 35 minutes of opening
items.description: The issue received bids worth about Rs 22,354 crore by 10:34 am, with qualified institutional buyers leading demand at 3.25 times their reserved portion
